tasks.title: Review and Ensure Complete Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Review and verify the existing mobile responsive implementation:

1. Read and analyze current responsive CSS:
   - src/components/Calculator.css - check media queries for mobile/tablet/desktop
   - src/components/Display.css - verify responsive font sizing and layout
   - src/components/Button.css - check button sizing on mobile devices
   - index.html - verify viewport meta tag is present and correct

2. Test responsive behavior:
   - Start dev server (npm run dev)
   - Take screenshots at key breakpoints: 375x667 (iPhone SE), 414x896 (iPhone 11 Pro Max), 768x1024 (tablet), 1920x1080 (desktop)
   - Save screenshots to .eunomia/screenshots/developer/

3. Fix any responsive issues found:
   - Ensure touch targets are appropriately sized (minimum 44x44px)
   - Verify text is readable without zooming
   - Check that layout adapts properly at all breakpoints
   - Ensure no horizontal scrolling on mobile

4. Write or update responsive tests:
   - Create/update tests in src/components/Calculator.test.tsx to verify responsive behavior
   - Test that components render correctly at different viewport sizes

Files to modify if needed:
- src/components/Calculator.css
- src/components/Display.css
- src/components/Button.css
- src/components/Calculator.test.tsx (for tests)
acceptance_criteria: Calculator displays correctly on mobile devices (375px wide and above)
All buttons are easily tappable on touch devices (44x44px minimum)
Text is readable without zooming on all device sizes
Layout adapts smoothly across breakpoints (mobile, tablet, desktop)
No horizontal scrolling on any device size

tasks.title: Validate Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Validate that the calculator application is fully responsive on mobile devices:

1. Run the test suite:
   - Execute: npm test
   - Verify all tests pass, especially responsive-related tests

2. Visual validation:
   - Start dev server: npm run dev
   - Take screenshots at multiple device sizes:
     * Mobile: 375x667 (iPhone SE), 414x896 (iPhone 11 Pro Max)
     * Tablet: 768x1024 (iPad)
     * Desktop: 1920x1080
   - Save screenshots to .eunomia/screenshots/qa/

3. Check responsive criteria:
   - Verify calculator is usable at all tested sizes
   - Confirm no layout breaking or horizontal scroll
   - Ensure buttons are appropriately sized for touch
   - Verify text readability

4. Review developer screenshots in .eunomia/screenshots/developer/ for comparison
acceptance_criteria: Calculator renders correctly on mobile devices (screenshots confirm)
Calculator renders correctly on tablet devices (screenshots confirm)
Calculator renders correctly on desktop devices (screenshots confirm)
No visual defects or layout issues at any breakpoint
Touch targets are appropriately sized on mobile
